reliability_caution: Clean-data calibration does not certify corrupted-input performance. Thresholds chosen on128 validation points can be optimistic. Coverage comparisons raw/calibrated use different predeclared rules, so not a pure temperature treatment estimate.
optimizer_caution: 59 of288 individual optimization runs in16 hit limits; all results/selection retained. Re-uploading and mixture each used72 runs and reported convergence. No exhaustive classical hyperparameter tuning, no optimality claim.
parameter_caution: 9 retained trainable mixture parameters after removing known null rotations; full functional independence not proved. Two quantum circuit branches incur separate measurement settings.
